greeting: Morning, Nyla — your Berlin listeners overtook LA overnight. Coffee's on. Let's use it.
headline: The Berlin spike is real and the window is open — one post and two approved pitches this week could turn a data blip into a foothold.

today_tasks.task: Open Spotify for Artists, go to 'Discovered On,' screenshot the top source driving Berlin
today_tasks.why: We can't pitch the momentum without knowing what's already carrying it.

today_tasks.task: Film the 'Slow Hours' bridge clip — warm lamp, stable phone, one take
today_tasks.why: That bridge is your most-replayed passage and Tuesday's Reel needs it ready to approve.

today_tasks.task: Read and approve (or edit) the two playlist pitches in your PR queue
today_tasks.why: Nothing sends without your okay — but the Berlin window doesn't stay open indefinitely.

today_tasks.task: Reply to 5 comments on last week's post in your own voice
today_tasks.why: Your engagement rate drops when you go quiet for 3+ days and the algorithm notices.

items: Post 'Slow Hours' bridge Reel at 9pm CET (Berlin primetime)
Reply to every comment within 2 hours of posting
Post 'what this song is about' carousel
DM any curator who added the track a thank-you
Threads post: ask which demo direction they want next
Reshare the best-performing clip of the week to Stories if engagement warrants it
10-minute weekly check-in: what landed, what didn't, what changed for next week
